description: Makes one picture now from the prompt you write: the whole scene in plain words (what is in it, the look, the light, the framing) and any words in the picture spelled exactly. The brand's own characters, look and design rules go with it on their own; name products by id to show them exactly, pass the owner's own pictures by the file id attachment_keep gives, and set logo true when the brand's logo belongs in it. One call makes one picture and spends its price in tokens, which the answer gives. It is sent to the chat the owner is in when it is made, and it lands in Create. To change a picture, call it again with the whole prompt rewritten. It spends the owner's tokens as the chat's same tool would: say the price before you spend.

aspect.description: its shape: 4:5 for a feed post (left out, 4:5), 1:1 square, 9:16 for a story or a reel, 16:9 wide

logo.description: true when the brand's logo belongs in it

pictures.description: the owner's own pictures it is made from, by the file ids attachment_keep gives

products.description: catalogue products it shows exactly, by their ids

project.description: The project's id or exact name. Optional when the account has one project.

prompt.description: the whole picture in plain words: what is in it, the look, the light, the framing, and any words in it spelled exactly; where the logo sits when logo is true

title.description: a short name for it, a few words

name: picture_make
title: Make a picture
